cipher.name: QwertyMirrorCipher
cipher.idea: A simple, deterministic monoalphabetic substitution cipher that mirrors the standard QWERTY keyboard layout. It maps the 26 letters of the alphabet to the QWERTY sequence in reverse order. This creates a highly intuitive, single-step bijection that is easy for language models to compute accurately, reducing reasoning errors while maintaining a distinct obfuscation layer. Case is preserved, and all non-alphabetic characters (including digits, spaces, and punctuation) remain completely unchanged.
cipher.encrypt_rules: Map each letter of the alphabet to the reversed QWERTY sequence. The standard QWERTY sequence is: 'qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm'. The reversed QWERTY sequence is: 'mnbvcxzlkjhgfdsaqpoiuytrew'. Specifically, 'a' maps to 'm', 'b' maps to 'n', 'c' maps to 'b', 'd' maps to 'v', 'e' maps to 'c', 'f' maps to 'x', 'g' maps to 'z', 'h' maps to 'l', 'i' maps to 'k', 'j' maps to 'j', 'k' maps to 'h', 'l' maps to 'g', 'm' maps to 'f', 'n' maps to 'd', 'o' maps to 's', 'p' maps to 'a', 'q' maps to 'q', 'r' maps to 'p', 's' maps to 'o', 't' maps to 'i', 'u' maps to 'u', 'v' maps to 'y', 'w' maps to 't', 'x' maps to 'r', 'y' maps to 'e', 'z' maps to 'w'. Case is preserved. Non-alphabetic characters are unchanged.
cipher.decrypt_rules: Reverse the mapping. Map each letter from the reversed QWERTY sequence back to the standard alphabet. Specifically, 'm' maps to 'a', 'n' maps to 'b', 'b' maps to 'c', 'v' maps to 'd', 'c' maps to 'e', 'x' maps to 'f', 'z' maps to 'g', 'l' maps to 'h', 'k' maps to 'i', 'j' maps to 'j', 'h' maps to 'k', 'g' maps to 'l', 'f' maps to 'm', 'd' maps to 'n', 's' maps to 'o', 'a' maps to 'p', 'q' maps to 'q', 'p' maps to 'r', 'o' maps to 's', 'i' maps to 't', 'u' maps to 'u', 'y' maps to 'v', 't' maps to 'w', 'r' maps to 'x', 'e' maps to 'y', 'w' maps to 'z'. Case is preserved. Non-alphabetic characters are unchanged.
